news.title: Prioticket partners with Great Days Out UK

summary: PrioTicket is all-in-one ticketing platform with all the e-commerce and point of sale features, designed for the travel industry., founded in 2014. Type: startup / scale-up. About 21 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: PrioTicket is a small Amsterdam ticketing-software company for tourism and attractions with an international team; IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: Builds an all-in-one ticketing platform connecting attraction operators with resellers, handling bookings, payments and redemption online and in-store.
A small team (21 people on LinkedIn), with staff from schools like Universitat de Lleida, Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences and Universidad Iberoamericana in Mexico.
Most people work in sales, product management, IT and engineering.

open.text: PrioTicket B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Staff backgrounds include Spanish and Mexican universities, pointing to an international team.

growth.text: Founded in 2014-2015 and says it is moving into smart tourism and connected-city work.
Partnered with Great Days Out UK.
